subject: english
stem: This exchange happens near the school entrance. What action or decision is reached by the end?
options: review the Wednesday summary and examples together
review only the summary on Wednesday
review the summary before writing the examples
submit the summary and examples without checking them together

optionRationales.reason: review the Wednesday summary and examples together：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。對話結尾確認「review the Wednesday summary and examples together」。

review only the summary on Wednesday：此項把「the Wednesday summary and examples together」改成「only the summary on Wednesday」。對話結尾確認「review the Wednesday summary and examples together」。因此，鎖定證據支持「review the Wednesday summary and examples together」。

review the summary before writing the examples：此項把「Wednesday summary and examples together」改成「summary before writing the examples」。對話結尾確認「review the Wednesday summary and examples together」。因此，鎖定證據支持「review the Wednesday summary and examples together」。

submit the summary and examples without checking them together：此項把「review the Wednesday summary and examples」改成「submit the summary and examples without checking them」。對話結尾確認「review the Wednesday summary and examples together」。因此，鎖定證據支持「review the Wednesday summary and examples together」。
